1.title: Trump’s Economic Approach Draws Concern From Some Republicans
1.summary: A plan to lower tariffs on imported beef and trade tensions with Canada have compounded some G.O.P. worries about a central issue in the midterms.

2.title: Trump’s Summer of Fun Ends With an IndyCar Race on the Streets of D.C.
2.summary: It was the final, major event planned for the nation’s 250th anniversary celebrations. The president took a lap.

3.title: French Tourist Dies in Death Valley During 116-Degree Heat
3.summary: The 68-year-old tourist and his companion were driving through Death Valley National Park on a remote road last week when their car got stuck in mud, officials said.

4.title: Trump waves green flag to start IndyCar race through Washington streets
4.summary: The president took a ceremonial lap of the track before the race, which is the culmination of a summer of events to mark the country's 250th birthday.

5.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
5.summary: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

6.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30
6.summary: A mound of rubbish at a major waste site buried several homes in the capital, the government says.
